gloss: fine wine; fine sake; excellent liquor

definitions.gloss: fine wine; fine sake; excellent liquor
definitions.explanation: High-quality alcoholic beverage, especially sake or wine. Often used figuratively to describe the sweet taste of victory or success.

examples.japanese: {勝利|しょうり}の{美酒|びしゅ}に{酔|よ}う。
examples.english: To savor the sweet taste of victory.

examples.japanese: この{蔵元|くらもと}は{毎年|まいとし}{美酒|びしゅ}を{生|う}み{出|だ}している。
examples.english: This brewery produces fine sake every year.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}り、チームは{優勝|ゆうしょう}の{美酒|びしゅ}を{味|あじ}わった。
examples.english: Years of effort bore fruit, and the team savored the sweet taste of a championship victory.

notes:
Compound of {美|び} (beautiful, fine) + {酒|しゅ} (sake, liquor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勝利|しょうり}の{美酒|びしゅ} (the sweet taste of victory)
- {美酒|びしゅ}に{酔|よ}う (to savor fine sake; to revel in success)
- {美酒|びしゅ}を{味|あじ}わう (to taste fine sake; to enjoy a sweet victory)

USAGE NOTE:
The figurative expression {勝利|しょうり}の{美酒|びしゅ}に{酔|よ}う is extremely common in sports journalism and news. In literal use, {美酒|びしゅ} is a somewhat literary way to praise the quality of sake or wine.
